I built schedules with every class ending by 3:00 PM. I'm showing two of the three results. Seats are as of 2026-11-13 15:00 UTC.

**Schedule 1 (15 credits, all on campus)**
- CSE 212-02 (Programming with Data Structures, 2 cr): T/R 12:45–1:45, STC 235. This fills Data Structures. 7 seats open.
- CSE 310-02 (Applied Programming, 3 cr): M/W/F 12:45–1:45, STC 380. This fills Applied Programming. 5 seats open.
- MATH 113-02 (Calculus II, 3 cr): M/W/F 10:15–11:15, RKS 103. This fills Calculus II. 3 seats open.
- WDD 231-01 (Web Frontend Development I, 2 cr): T/R 11:30–12:30, STC 150. This fills Web Frontend. 5 seats open.
- REL 275-01 (Book of Mormon, 2 cr): T/R 10:15–11:15, TAY 120. This fills the Religion requirement. 12 seats open.
- CIT 225-01 (Database Design, 3 cr): M/W/F 11:30–12:30, STC 140. This fills Database Design. 6 seats open.

**Schedule 2 (13 credits)**
- CSE 212-03 (online, 2 cr): no set meeting times. 15 seats open.
- MATH 113-03 (3 cr): T/R 11:30–12:45, RKS 103. 8 seats open.
- CSE 310-02 (3 cr): M/W/F 12:45–1:45, STC 380. 5 seats open.
- CIT 225-01 (3 cr): M/W/F 11:30–12:30, STC 140. 6 seats open.
- REL 275-02 (2 cr): T/R 12:45–1:45, TAY 120. 25 seats open.

I left out the third schedule. Its CSE 212-04 meets M/W until 4:15 PM, and its CSE 310-03 runs until 3:00 PM, so it breaks your 3 PM limit.

I didn't set a credit range, so the school default applies.
